## Overview

Profile Header presents profile identity, verification status, an optional balance line in the scrolled layout, and a trailing notification action. Its API exposes status, layout, balance visibility, user-name, avatar-initial, and balance-copy inputs while Light/Dark colors remain theme-controlled. The notification bell is the only independently focusable control evidenced by the extraction.

**Variant axes.** `Status` (`Pending`, `Error`, `Success`; default `Success`), `State` (`Default`, `Scrolled`; default `Default`), `Balance` (`Show`, `None`, `Hide`; default `None`)

### Composition

- **bell** (constitutive sub-component) — documented inline; also has its own spec at `./bell.md` (when present).
- _Decorative children: 1 — documented inline in Structure and Color._

## API

_Confidence: high._

> The status axis selects the persistent verification outcome and corresponding status icon. The layoutState axis controls the compact versus scrolled layout. Balance visibility is meaningful only in the scrolled layout; use none in the default layout, visible to show the amount, or obscured to mask it. Light and dark appearance are supplied by semantic theme tokens rather than component properties.

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | enum | pending, error, success | `success` | Persistent profile verification outcome. Maps to the Figma Status axis and selects the matching status icon. |
| `layoutState` | enum | default, scrolled | `default` | Layout presentation mapped from the Figma State axis; scrolled reveals the compact balance row. |
| `balanceVisibility` | enum | none, visible, obscured | `none` | Maps Figma Balance values None, Show, and Hide to an engineer-facing visibility contract. Applies when layoutState is scrolled. |
| `userName` | string | string | `–` | Profile display name rendered in the user-name text layer. |
| `avatarInitials` | string | string | `CW` | Fallback initials rendered by the Avatar child when no picture is supplied. |
| `balanceAmount` | string | string | `–` | Formatted balance text shown when layoutState is scrolled and balanceVisibility is visible. |

### Example 1 — Default verified profile

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | success | Shows the verified status treatment. |
| `layoutState` | default | Uses the standard header layout. |
| `balanceVisibility` | none | No balance row in the default layout. |
| `userName` | "Cameron Brooklyn Williamson" | Profile display name. |

### Example 2 — Scrolled profile with visible balance

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `layoutState` | scrolled | Uses the compact scrolled presentation. |
| `balanceVisibility` | visible | Shows the formatted balance. |
| `balanceAmount` | "9,999.99 THB" | Formatted monetary value. |

### Example 3 — Error profile with obscured balance

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | error | Shows the failed verification treatment. |
| `layoutState` | scrolled | Uses the compact scrolled presentation. |
| `balanceVisibility` | obscured | Masks the balance amount. |

### Profile Header — Default

Default profile header structure. The root distributes user information and the notification action across the available width.

| Spec | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Profile Header | – | Root horizontal container. |
| ├ height | 40 | Compact default header height. |
| ├ verticalPadding | 0 | Content defines the header height without extra vertical inset. |
| ├ horizontalPadding | space-16 (16) | Uses the shared space-16 edge inset on both logical sides. |
| ├ itemSpacing | — | primaryAxisAlignItems=SPACE_BETWEEN; the rendered value is width-dependent and must not be hard-coded. |
| User info | – | Avatar, user name, and verification status form the leading identity zone. |
| ├ itemSpacing | 8 | Maintains a consistent optical gap between identity elements. |
| User name container | – | Hug-sized name row aligned with the verification glyph. |
| ├ itemSpacing | 8 | Keeps the name and adjacent verification content visually separated. |
| └ textStyle | Label/Base | Shared label style for the user name. |

### Profile Header — Scrolled

Scrolled structure adds a second text line for balance. Layer IDs vary by Status and Balance combination, so the section anchor uses the canonical Scrolled zone name without a single node ID.

| Spec | Show | Hide | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Scrolled container | – | – | Structural configuration present only in Scrolled variants; no single default-variant layer ID exists. |
| ├ height | 44 | 44 | Adds four units over Default to accommodate the balance line. |
| ├ verticalPadding | 0 | 0 | The two-line content determines the container height. |
| ├ horizontalPadding | space-16 (16) | space-16 (16) | Preserves the Default layout edge inset while scrolling. |
| ├ itemSpacing | — | — | primaryAxisAlignItems=SPACE_BETWEEN; the rendered value is width-dependent and must not be hard-coded. |
| Identity text stack | – | – | Vertical stack containing name and balance; layer IDs differ across Scrolled combinations. |
| ├ itemSpacing | space-4 (4) | space-4 (4) | Tokenized compact separation keeps the balance visually associated with the user name. |
| ├ userNameTextStyle | Label/Base | Label/Base | The primary identity line retains the Default typography. |
| └ balanceTextStyle | Label/Tiny | Label/Tiny | Smaller label style establishes secondary hierarchy for balance. |

## Voice / Screen reader

_Confidence: high._ _Reconciliation: 0 auto-fixed, 0 retried, 1 unresolved._

> - The notification bell is the only independently interactive focus stop evidenced by the extracted default variant; the profile container, avatar, user name, verification icon, and balance text are not separate controls.
> - Expose the user name, verification status, and balance as readable page content or merge them into a separately implemented profile action only when product behavior confirms that action; do not infer an action from visual grouping alone.
> - Keep the notification control's accessible name concise and stable across status, scroll, and balance variants.
> - Do not announce the bell glyph itself; expose the control as a named button and hide the decorative icon subtree.
> - Do not stuff the accessible name with state or instructions; each belongs on its dedicated property.
> - Preserve platform parity: VoiceOver, TalkBack, and ARIA should expose the same notification action.

### State: pending / error / success

Status variants and the Default / Scrolled visual layouts share the same screen-reader behavior for the notification action; Balance variants do not change this focus stop.

#### VoiceOver (iOS)

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Announcement | "Notifications, button" | — |
| accessibilityLabel | Notifications | Names the icon-only action without including its role. |
| accessibilityTraits | .isButton | Exposes the notification action as a button. |
| Do NOT | Do not announce the bell glyph | Mark the decorative icon subtree accessibilityElementsHidden=true so it does not duplicate the button name. |

#### TalkBack (Android)

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Announcement | "Notifications, button, double-tap to activate" | — |
| contentDescription | Notifications | Provides the spoken name for the icon-only action. |
| role | Role.Button | Exposes the notification action as a button. |
| Do NOT | Do not announce the bell glyph | Set the decorative icon contentDescription to null or importantForAccessibility=no to avoid duplicate speech. |

#### ARIA (Web)

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Announcement | "Notifications, button" | — |
| element | <button type="button"> | Uses native button semantics and keyboard behavior. |
| aria-label | Notifications | Names the icon-only button when no visible label is present. |
| Do NOT | Do not announce the bell glyph | Set aria-hidden=true on the decorative icon so it does not duplicate the button name. |
